data.name: Too Hot to Be True
data.detailed_description:
Game Description

“Can anyone just marry me, please?!”

One phone call from your parents

has successfully turned your peaceful life upside down.

You are Gong Juin, owner of a seaside guesthouse.

But more importantly right now, you need to find yourself a bride before your parents arrive next week!

With such a tight deadline, you set your sights on the guesthouse you run,

where you currently host five beautiful women.

From your adorable childhood friend,

a dangerously charming office lady,

to a free-spirited beauty from overseas who turns heads wherever she goes...

"Let's start by finding a girlfriend, for now. Even a fake one should work!"

What starts as a lighthearted decision

slowly changes as you begin living together under the same roof,

and feelings you never expected begin to surface.

Connections you thought would be fleeting

become something much harder to walk away from.

In this seaside guesthouse, just like the way small ripples make a big wave,

your choices will shape every relationship and every outcome.

And when the final day arrives...

Who will you end up marrying?

Heroines

Suah – Your Childhood Friend

"How would you still be alive if it wasn't for me?"

The self-proclaimed “lady of the guesthouse,”

she’s been by your side since kindergarten.

She believes she knows you better than anyone.

Gyeoul - The Sexy Office Lady

“You’re different from other men, Juin.”

A careerwoman who escaped Seoul in search of a break,

she’s intelligent, detail-oriented, and a perfectionist.

Despite her cold exterior, she occasionally shows a warm side... but only to you.

Jinny – The Mysterious Country Girl

“If you had to choose, would it be love or money? …I’d choose love.”

She adapts to new environments almost too easily,

and sometimes doesn’t seem like an ordinary country girl at all.

Is she really who she says she is?

Or is she hiding something?

Ejung – The Fit and Fun Korean-American

“I can do this! I’m totally a No.1 wife!”

A bold and energetic fitness lover who says it like it is.

Her lively personality and unique way of speaking paints your heart in new colors,

but when she asks you to “work out”… does she really just mean exercise?

Cherry – The Influencer

“You just have this... charm that just draws people in!”

A bright, cheerful YouTuber with 110K subscribers.

She turns everything into content and even plans her own events.

With her quirky charm, she naturally becomes the center of attention, but...

Key Features

☀️ Immersive story through a first-person POV

You will experience the entire game through the perspective of Juin, the male lead.

Talk to the girls, make choices, and deepen your relationship with them

as the owner of the seaside guesthouse

living with the ladies through a realistic immersive experience.

🎬 Even more abundant story and emotions

Each heroine has their own emotional route and multiple endings,

with new event cuts and bonus videos enriching the gameplay experience.

Fun times under the sun by the sea, romantic party night in the guest house, and everything in between,

a variety of emotions through the experiences naturally flows your way.

💖 Multiple heroines with various quirks perfect for the summer

Childhood friend, office lady, country girl, sporty fitness lover, and influencer;

each heroine has her own unique charm and personality,

getting closer to you in their own way.

Innocence, boldness, mystery, excitement…

there’s someone here who will be exactly your type.

About Us

Hello!

We are Storytaco, an interactive game developer.

This time, we are back with our first collaboration with DAERISOFT!

We're able to come back with this new title thanks to your passionate love on our FMVs thus far,

and we truly appreciate it from the bottom of our hearts.

Set in a seaside guesthouse, this title delivers a more vivid and immersive drama than ever before.

With the refreshing ocean and a cast of captivating heroines,

we hope you enjoy the story your choices create.

We’ve done our best to bring your expectations, imagination, and desires to life through this game.

Your continued support and feedback mean everything to us, and we’ll keep striving to improve.

We're so excited to share our next story with all of you.

Thank you as always, and we hope you have fun playing!

data.short_description: “Finding a wife in a week? Are you for real?!" Your parents are visiting next week, and they expect you to show up with a bride. With only days left, your only hope may be the five gorgeous women staying at your seaside guesthouse. As feelings shift fast, who will you choose?
